exec: const clientWork = projects.find((project) => project.name === 'Filtering - Client Work');
pm.test('Both active filtering projects exist', function () { pm.expect(clientWork).to.exist; pm.expect(personal).to.exist; });
pm.test('Task list returns an array', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an('array'); });

function localToday() { const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-US', { timeZone: 'Asia/Manila', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).formatToParts(new Date()); const part = (type) => parts.find((value) => value.type === type).value; return `${part('year')}-${part('month')}-${part('day')}`; }
function shiftDate(date, days) { const value = new Date(`${date}T00:00:00.000Z`); value.setUTCDate(value.getUTCDate() + days); return value.toISOString().slice(0, 10); }

function requestCase(name, query, check) { const baseQuery = query.includes('status=') ? 'pageSize=100' : 'status=all&pageSize=100'; pm.sendRequest({ url: `${pm.environment.get('baseUrl')}/tasks?${baseQuery}&${query}`, method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${pm.environment.get('token')}` } }, function (error, response) { pm.test(`${name} returns 200`, function () { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); }); if (!error && response.code === 200) { const rows = response.json(); pm.test(name, function () { pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); check(rows); }); } }); }

pm.sendRequest({ url: `${pm.environment.get('baseUrl')}/tasks?pageSize=100`, method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${pm.environment.get('token')}` } }, function (error, response) { pm.test('Omitted status includes active and completed tasks', function () { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); const rows = response.json(); pm.expect(rows.some((task) => task.isDone)).to.equal(true); pm.expect(rows.some((task) => !task.isDone)).to.equal(true); }); });
requestCase('Legacy single label ID', `labelId=${filteringLabelId}`, (rows) => pm.expect(rows.every((task) => task.labels.some((label) => label.id === Number(filteringLabelId)))).to.equal(true));

requestCase('Multiple labels match any by default', `labelIds=${filteringLabelId},${reviewLabelId}`, (rows) => pm.expect(rows.every((task) => task.labels.some((label) => [Number(filteringLabelId), Number(reviewLabelId)].includes(label.id)))).to.equal(true));

requestCase('Multiple labels match all', `labelIds=${filteringLabelId},${reviewLabelId}&labelMatch=all`, (rows) => pm.expect(rows.every((task) => [Number(filteringLabelId), Number(reviewLabelId)].every((id) => task.labels.some((label) => label.id === id)))).to.equal(true));

requestCase('dueFrom is inclusive', `dueFrom=${past}`, (rows) => { pm.expect(rows.every((task) => task.dueDate === null || task.dueDate >= past)).to.equal(true); pm.expect(rows.some((task) => task.title === 'Filter fixture 01: overdue low')).to.equal(true); });

requestCase('dueTo is inclusive', `dueTo=${future}`, (rows) => { pm.expect(rows.every((task) => task.dueDate === null || task.dueDate <= future)).to.equal(true); pm.expect(rows.some((task) => task.title === 'Filter fixture 06: future high')).to.equal(true); });

requestCase('Date range includes both edges', `dueFrom=${past}&dueTo=${future}`, (rows) => { pm.expect(rows.some((task) => task.title === 'Filter fixture 01: overdue low')).to.equal(true); pm.expect(rows.some((task) => task.title === 'Filter fixture 06: future high')).to.equal(true); });
requestCase('Tasks with due dates', 'hasDueDate=true', (rows) => pm.expect(rows.every((task) => task.dueDate !== null)).to.equal(true));
requestCase('Tasks without due dates', 'hasDueDate=false', (rows) => pm.expect(rows.every((task) => task.dueDate === null)).to.equal(true));
requestCase('Overdue excludes completed tasks', 'overdue=true', (rows) => pm.expect(rows.every((task) => !task.isDone && task.dueDate < today)).to.equal(true));
requestCase('Recurring tasks', 'recurring=true', (rows) => pm.expect(rows.every((task) => task.recurrence !== 'none' && task.recurrence !== null)).to.equal(true));
requestCase('Non-recurring tasks', 'recurring=false', (rows) => pm.expect(rows.every((task) => task.recurrence === 'none' || task.recurrence === null)).to.equal(true));

requestCase('Combined filters use AND', `priorities=low,high&labelIds=${filteringLabelId},${reviewLabelId}&labelMatch=all&dueFrom=${past}&dueTo=${future}&hasDueDate=true&recurring=false`, (rows) => { pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.greaterThan(0); pm.expect(rows.every((task) => ['low', 'high'].includes(task.priority) && task.dueDate >= past && task.dueDate <= future && task.recurrence === 'none' && [Number(filteringLabelId), Number(reviewLabelId)].every((id) => task.labels.some((label) => label.id === id)))).to.equal(true); });
pm.test('Task sort baseline returns 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

function requestSort(orderBy, direction) { pm.sendRequest({ url: `${pm.environment.get('baseUrl')}/tasks?status=all&pageSize=100&orderBy=${orderBy}&orderDirection=${direction}`, method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${pm.environment.get('token')}` } }, function (error, response) { const name = `Task ${orderBy} ${direction}`; pm.test(`${name} returns 200`, function () { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); }); if (!error && response.code === 200) { const rows = response.json(); const rank = { low: 0, medium: 1, high: 2 }; const value = (task) => orderBy === 'priority' ? rank[task.priority] : task[orderBy]; const compare = (left, right) => { const a = value(left); const b = value(right); if (a === null || a === undefined) return b === null || b === undefined ? 0 : 1; if (b === null || b === undefined) return -1; const order = typeof a === 'string' ? a.localeCompare(b) : a - b; return direction === 'asc' ? order : -order; }; pm.test(`${name} is ordered with nulls last and stable IDs`, function () { for (let index = 1; index < rows.length; index += 1) { const order = compare(rows[index - 1], rows[index]); pm.expect(order <= 0).to.equal(true); if (order === 0) pm.expect(rows[index - 1].id).to.be.at.most(rows[index].id); } }); } }); }

pm.test('Limited project list returns projects and total', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.projects).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(body.total).to.be.a('number'); });

function requestProjectCase(name, query, check) { pm.sendRequest({ url: `${pm.environment.get('baseUrl')}/projects?${query}`, method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${pm.environment.get('token')}` } }, function (error, response) { pm.test(`${name} returns 200`, function () { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); }); if (!error && response.code === 200) pm.test(name, function () { check(response.json()); }); }); }
requestProjectCase('Omitted archive filter returns active projects', '', (rows) => pm.expect(rows.every((project) => !project.isArchived)).to.equal(true));

requestProjectCase('Color filter ignores case', 'color=%233c78d8', (rows) => { pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.greaterThan(0); pm.expect(rows.every((project) => project.color.toUpperCase() === '#3C78D8')).to.equal(true); });

['sortOrder', 'name', 'createdAt', 'updatedAt'].forEach((orderBy) => ['asc', 'desc'].forEach((direction) => pm.sendRequest({ url: `${pm.environment.get('baseUrl')}/projects?isArchived=false&limit=100&orderBy=${orderBy}&orderDirection=${direction}`, method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${pm.environment.get('token')}` } }, function (error, response) { const name = `Project ${orderBy} ${direction}`; pm.test(`${name} returns a limited response`, function () { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(200); pm.expect(response.json().projects).to.be.an('array'); }); if (!error && response.code === 200) { const projects = response.json().projects; pm.test(`${name} is ordered with stable IDs`, function () { for (let index = 1; index < projects.length; index += 1) { const left = projects[index - 1][orderBy]; const right = projects[index][orderBy]; const order = typeof left === 'string' ? left.localeCompare(right) : left - right; pm.expect(direction === 'asc' ? order <= 0 : order >= 0).to.equal(true); if (order === 0) pm.expect(projects[index - 1].id).to.be.at.most(projects[index].id); } }); } })));
requestProjectCase('Limit returns a bounded page and total', 'limit=1', (body) => { pm.expect(body.projects).to.have.length.at.most(1); pm.expect(body.total).to.be.at.least(body.projects.length); });
requestProjectCase('Omitted limit preserves the array response', 'isArchived=false', (body) => pm.expect(body).to.be.an('array'));

function expectBadRequest(name, path) { pm.sendRequest({ url: `${pm.environment.get('baseUrl')}${path}`, method: 'GET', header: { Authorization: `Bearer ${pm.environment.get('token')}` } }, function (error, response) { pm.test(`${name} returns 400`, function () { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.equal(400); }); }); }
pm.test('Missing task token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Missing project token returns 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
